feedback.details: Mermaid diagram passes mmdc validation (exit 0). All containers have technology labels in parentheses (e.g., Node.js/Express, Python, Markdown/PostgreSQL). Dependencies are labeled arrows with protocols. Cross-reference table (c2-container.md:137-158) maps arrows to PRD references. However, node IDs use the format `id_<NAME>` (e.g., `id_api_gw`, `id_qr_scan` at c2-container.md:26-35) instead of the contract-required `id_<SECTION>_<NAME>` format. The SECTION component is entirely absent — should be `id_gateway_api_gw`, `id_function_qr_scan`, etc. Additionally, non-standard Mermaid node shapes: `[("...")]` for Plant Data Storage (c2-container.md:33, cylinder) and `[["..."]]` for Hermes Agent and Telegram API (c2-container.md:34-35, double-bracket) deviate from standard C4 container notation.

Comprehensive auth specification in deployment.md. JWT RS256 specified (line 16), all required claims present — iss (line 18), sub (line 19), exp (line 20), scope (line 21), plus aud (line 22). Token expiration ≤24h (line 20). Refresh strategy describes rotation on use (line 35). Environment variables explicitly listed: JWT_ISSUER, JWT_AUDIENCE, JWT_PUBLIC_KEY, HERMES_ENDPOINT, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN (lines 26-32). Threat model subsection present (lines 40-50) covering FR36-FR40 with 6 defense-in-depth controls. Minor gap: no explicit JWKS endpoint for key discovery.

All required parameters specified: Kubernetes HPA (deployment.md:57), min=1/max=10 replicas (lines 58-59), CPU>70% or memory>80% sustained for 2 minutes (lines 60-62), 5-minute cooldown (line 65), explicit rollback policy (line 69). Load test k6 YAML snippet (lines 74-103) validates 50 simultaneous QR scan peak load. Minor gap: load test plant ID format does not match VARIETY-YYYY-SEQ from FR2.

OpenTelemetry-compliant stack (deployment.md:107-199). JSON logging with traceID/correlationID (lines 112-119) with sample entry. /metrics endpoint exposes qr_scans_total and hermes_analysis_latency_seconds. W3C TraceContext propagation (line 158). Prometheus alert YAML with >5% 5xx errors (line 174) and p95>2s latency (line 183). Log retention ≥30 days (line 122). Minor gap: no Prometheus scrape interval or metrics retention policy.

feedback.criterion: PRD Accuracy for Edge Function Responsibilities
feedback.details: deployment.md traceability table (lines 203-233) now covers FR12-FR21, FR36-FR41 — improvement from Round 1. Edge function as data access layer stated (c2-container.md:15-16, 165). Hermes webhook via HERMES_ENDPOINT (deployment.md:31). Plant records markdown per FR7-FR11 referenced (deployment.md:208-212, 296). CRITICAL GAP: Anchor cross-links (#fr12) present in c2-container.md (lines 139-158) but entirely absent in deployment.md — contract requires anchor cross-links in BOTH files. c2-container.md also lacks a proper traceability table mapping FRs to config keys.

feedback.criterion: Edge Case: Hermes Agent Fallback Documentation
feedback.details: Comprehensive fallback in deployment.md (lines 235-285). Offline mode (line 240), Redis queue ≤1000 depth (line 243), exponential backoff 2^attempt×1s capped at 60s (line 244), user notification message (line 245), idempotency key format (line 246), dead letter queue (line 247). Sequence diagram validates FR6-FR11 data integrity (lines 250-276). Fallback Behavior Matrix covers 5 scenarios (lines 278-285). Minor gap: no queue persistence guarantee during Redis failure.

overall_summary: Sprint 6 Round 2 shows targeted improvement in PRD traceability — deployment.md now includes FR17-FR21 and node IDs gained the `id_` prefix (though the full `id_<SECTION>_<NAME>` format is still not met). Authentication, scaling, observability, and Hermes fallback remain strong at 9.0. However, Markdown Readability & Linting Standards remains a critical blocker at 4.0 — both files have massive markdownlint violations (41 and 107 errors), dominated by MD013 line-length violations in traceability tables and systematic MD022 heading spacing errors. PRD Accuracy scored 6.5 because anchor cross-links (#fr12) are missing from deployment.md and c2-container.md lacks a proper traceability table mapping FRs to config keys.
